blurb: Guests join guided fishing trips targeting various species inshore and offshore around Anna Maria Island. Trips are personalized to group needs and include local knowledge and top fishing gear. Other adventure packages include snorkel, sandbar, and sunset trips.

quotes.text: Captain Taylor was a awesome. We went on a half-day inshore fishing trip with my dad for his birthday and Captain Taylor showed us a great time. We caught half-a-dozen snook or so and a random catfish. It was beautiful tooling round the bay and the captain knows the area extremely well. The pick-up and drop-off was easy and there was plenty of parking. It made it easy to enjoy the afternoon on the water.
Awesome fishing guide and awesome service! Our captain really knew where all the fish were. Will definitely book again with him when I come back for vacation!
